verdicts.reason: A: the red ribbon is stretched across almost the whole canvas and overlaps the headline and the bottle cap, the bottle is shrunk and jammed against the left edge, and the legal text floats ragged at the bottom right, so the layout reads as collisions rather than intent. B: a sensible left-to-right banner with the large headline on the left, the CTA with its supporting copy and legal text grouped on the right, and the logo and ribbon kept intact; but the product bottle is shrunk into the top-right corner, where it crowds the decorative circle and loses its role as the hero, and the legal text sits close to the bottom edge.
